newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland approves partial sell-off of TPSA telecom.
newsitem.headline: Poland approves partial sell-off of TPSA telecom.

text.p: The Polish government on Tuesday approved a plan to float up to 25 percent of the state telecommunications monopoly TPSA in 1998 on Polish and international markets, the telecommunications minister said.

"Our concept is that the sale of TPSA (Telekomunikacja Polska SA) will start in 1998 and the government's decision today brings to a close a key stage of discussions and we are...entering the implementation stage," Andrzej Zielinski told a news conference.

Zielinski said the government plan assumed that the TPSA, Poland biggest state firm, would be privatised in stages with the first next year envisaging a public offering for both institutional and retail investors in Poland and abroad.
